thought_process.skill_suggestions: Add an automated interval ticker (auto-increment simulator) to demonstrate streaming data visualization.
assumed_from_scratch: State management for multi-functional counting, dynamic steps, targets, logs, and chart histories
Recharts integration for tracking counter velocity and value trends
Dual-theme implementation using strict arbitrary Tailwind classes corresponding to the visual spec hex codes
thought_process.interpretation: The user requested a simple counter app. To deliver an enterprise-grade experience adhering to the visual and layout rules, we will elevate this into a 'Metric Tally & Event Simulator Dashboard'. It features a highly interactive primary counter with dynamic step settings, a user-defined target goal (enabling a functional progress bar), a live trend chart of the count history using Recharts, and an audit log table detailing every state change. It supports a fully functional Light/Dark theme toggle using the exact hex tokens specified in the design guide.
